
### Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN)

* Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) are a type of deep learning algorithm that are used to generate new data from existing data. 
* GANs are composed of two neural networks - a generator and a discriminator.
* The generator network is responsible for creating new data from existing data. It takes input from a random noise vector and produces an output that is similar to the existing data.
* The discriminator network is responsible for distinguishing between real data and fake data generated by the generator. It takes input from both the generator and the real data and produces an output that indicates whether the data is real or fake.
* GANs are used in a variety of applications, such as image generation, text generation, and music generation.
* GANs have been shown to be effective in producing high-quality results.
